defaultPrompt: Create a product-specific interface. Inspect the actual product and content, generate three structurally distinct rendered concepts, run the design divergence gate, then implement and review the selected concept.
Redesign this interface radically. Capture the old structure, explore three rendered alternatives, prove structural divergence from the baseline, and verify the final browser result.
Audit this website for repeated AI-template patterns and identify structural fixes before cosmetic changes.
Run the Web Forge release gate and report PASS, FAIL, and NOT VERIFIED with evidence.
interface.longDescription: A product-first web design and engineering workflow. It models real user tasks and content, requires three structurally different rendered concepts before substantial implementation, validates their layout fingerprints, then builds and verifies the selected interface with accessibility, testing, browser QA, performance, and security evidence.
interface.shortDescription: Design with product context. Build and verify.

name: web-forge
description: A product-specific web engineering copilot with rendered structural design exploration, measurable divergence gates, implementation, accessibility, testing, browser QA, performance, security, and release verification.
